prose:
A cached read of the GeminiApp post announces GIF creation in Gemini using a model it calls Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash. The post advertises looping photo effects and memes, with smooth motion and frame consistency presented as product claims.

An alternate read of the post was unavailable. The cached primary text supports the announcement but not a full feature matrix, geographic rollout, pricing or an independent quality test. No images were uploaded or generated. A marketing example does not establish reliable motion or safety across arbitrary requests.
highlights: Primary cached text announces GIF creation
Looping effects and memes are advertised uses
Rollout, price and output quality were not independently checked
